scientific.integrity: For source-form Adam-GC at zero moments, the bias-corrected first step reduces to coordinatewise h/(|h|+ε). A sign-mass splitting and strict Jensen comparison establish the exact dimension-sharp mean-drift supremum α(d−2)/d for d≥3 and zero drift at d=2. This statement does not claim a new GC2 implementation.
limitations: First-step zero-moment scope, with positive α, ε and no weight decay.
Later moment histories or other Adam variants can have different drift laws.
Worst-case sharpness does not imply typical large drift in neural-network training.
Final-delta centralization was known in the defining implementation.

title: Adam-GC has a sharp dimension-dependent mean-drift envelope
